MD simulation of POPC bilayer with CHARMM36 force field, 200 mM NaCl
MD simulation of POPC bilayer with CHARMM36 force field, 200 mM NaCl
Dataset contains simulation files including centered and equilibrated trajectory Nacl200mM-45-500ns.xtc.
System: POPC bilayer in water
Number of lipids: 200 (100/leaflet)
Number of waters: 8880
Salt: NaCl
Concentration: 200 mM
Number of cations: 32
Simulation time: 500 ns
Simulation engine: GROMACS 2019.5
Temperature: 300 K
